source_integrity.duplicate_code_result: OOB transport variant; reviewed IB counterpart 1245 confirms the same status-versus-run distinction while channel evidence remains separate.

source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES one approved raw 0x0A/0x2C run with target-specific state and repository validation.

historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Separates status query from a state-changing run.
historical_reviews.history: IB record 1245 requires FRU/SDR baseline, bounded polling and monitoring oracle.
historical_reviews.v3_1: A read-only status query is partial evidence, not functional run coverage.

original_test_intent: Run the platform SDR initialization agent once over OOB, observe it to completion and prove the approved repository and sensor effects.
original_method: Master TBD; review permits target-documented 0x0A/0x2C status/run forms only after schema and rebuild scope approval.
manual_activity: Owner selects a real run, approves regenerated content and assigns recovery for a stuck or inconsistent agent.
safety_requirements: Stop and preserve evidence on timeout

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek refusal is safe but does not distinguish status from an approved run.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Query documented 0x0A/0x2C status first; set the verified run bit once only after confirmation, then boundedly poll status.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD and timing retained; no bits or expected records guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Separate status/run checkpoints and validate exact post-run SDR and sensor health against a captured baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds a conditional state machine without changing Master.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Status or completion alone cannot prove the initialization result.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A run may regenerate monitoring data and may need vendor recovery.

project_override_considerations: Vendor API is equivalent only if it exposes status/run distinction, bounded completion and record-level effects over the approved OOB path.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: State-changing title conflicts with TBD Procedure/Criteria and evidence-clearing boilerplate; run bits and acceptance are absent.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Operation family is identifiable; platform schema, expectation and recovery are readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Prevents status-only false coverage and uncontrolled reinitialization.
independent_technical_reasoning: Initialization can rebuild monitoring data, so command success is not the acceptance condition. The case must distinguish querying from initiating, compare exact pre/post records, and prove sensor health after one bounded OOB run; otherwise it risks both false PASS and repeated state change.

source_provenance.history: IB counterpart record 1245 and neighboring SDR lifecycle cases
